blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Match each expression with its simplified form.
blocks.display: Match each expression with its simplified form.

blocks.text: Two x plus three x minus x. Two plus three minus one is four, so four x.
x plus x. One plus one is two, so two x.
x times x. This is multiplication, not addition, so it is x squared.
Five y minus five y plus y. Five minus five plus one is one, so just y.
Every expression now has its simplified form. Adding like terms adds coefficients; multiplying x by x makes x squared.
